B: Vantrue Sonnet 1 Pro Max (S1 Pro Max) 4K+4K Dual Dash Cam
G: Front and rear dash cam recording true 4K on both channels with dual Sony STARVIS 2 sensors, HDR and 155° wide-angle lenses. Includes AI driver alerts (ADAS and blind spot detection), PlatePix licence plate capture, IP67 waterproof rear camera, built-in GPS, 5GHz Wi-Fi, voice control, 24/7 buffered parking mode, supercapacitor and microSD support up to 1TB. Optional LTE module (sold separately) adds remote live view and alerts. Upgraded version of the Vantrue S1 Pro.
H: The Vantrue Sonnet 1 Pro Max is the updated version of Vantrue's S1 Pro and the only Vantrue dash cam with true 4K recording on both the front and rear cameras. Both channels record in 4K (3840 x 2160) at 30 frames per second through 155° wide-angle lenses, so the rear footage is as detailed as the front. This matters when the evidence comes from behind, such as rear-end collisions, tailgating and parking lot damage. The rear camera is IP67 waterproof, so it can be mounted inside the rear window or outside the vehicle on trucks, vans and trailers for clearer, glare-free footage. Hands-Free voice controls allowing you to start / stop recording, take images, and turn off Wifi by using simple voice commands.
J: S1 Pro Max Dash Cam, rear camera, GPS mount
K:
- True dual 4K recording: 4K front + 4K rear at 30fps
- Dual Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 sensors with HDR on both channels
- 155° wide-angle lenses
- PlatePix licence plate capture
- AI driver alerts: forward collision, lane departure, pedestrian detection, blind spot detection, lane change assist, rear collision warning
- IP67 waterproof rear camera for interior or exterior mounting
- Optional LTE module (sold separately) for remote live view, geofencing, alerts, cloud storage and location tracking
- 24/7 buffered parking mode (hardwire kit required)
- 5GHz Wi-Fi and free app
- Smart voice control
- Built-in GPS logger
- Supercapacitor for heat and cold reliability
- microSD support up to 1TB

H: Night Vision: Both cameras use the Sony STARVIS 2 IMX678 sensor for clear low-light video with less noise. HDR on both channels balances bright and dark areas at night and in high-contrast scenes, such as tunnel exits, oncoming headlights and harsh sunlight. Vantrue's PlatePix technology is designed to make licence plates easier to read in strong backlight and low light.

AI Driver Alerts: Vantrue Intelligence adds AI-based driving alerts, including forward collision warning, lane departure warning, pedestrian detection, blind spot detection, lane change assist and rear collision warning. This brings driver assistance features to older vehicles that didn't come with them from the factory.

LTE Connectivity (Optional): The S1 Pro Max supports LTE, but the LTE module is sold separately. With the module installed, owners get real-time remote live view, GPS location tracking, geofencing, cloud storage and incident alerts. If the camera detects suspicious movement, such as someone approaching or trying to break into the vehicle, it can send an alert to the owner's phone. The owner can then check the live feed remotely.

Parking Protection: The 24/7 parking mode includes buffered motion detection that saves footage from before and after an event, plus impact detection and low-bitrate recording for long-term coverage. Parking mode requires a hardwire kit.

Built-in GPS logs route, speed and location with each recording, which helps with insurance claims and incident reviews. 5GHz Wi-Fi and the free Vantrue app let owners view, download and share clips without removing the memory card. Smart voice control allows hands-free operation. A supercapacitor instead of a battery gives better reliability in hot and cold weather. The camera supports microSD cards up to 1TB.
The S1 Pro Max suits daily commuters, fleet and work vehicles, and drivers who want the highest-resolution front and rear evidence available in a 2-channel system, plus AI safety alerts.
